findings.comment: Reduced clearances (less than 5 feet) to buildings are not documented, nor is written Austin Energy Design approval provided. No verification provided that required conditions are met: (1) not in confined space, (2) 10 ft+ to windows/doors/ducts, (3) 15 ft+ vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts, and (4) minimum 3-hour fire rating in clearance area.

Transformer equipment specifications (oil-filled vs. dry-type) are not provided on electrical plan. Without equipment type designation, minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance requirement from windows, doors, or ventilating ducts cannot be verified.

Access door orientation is not indicated on transformer pad callouts. Without door orientation designation, hot-stick use area clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: East-middle and Southeast transformer pad locations in building courtyards
findings.comment: Two transformer pads are located in courtyard areas between buildings. Whether these locations qualify as 'confined space' (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides) triggering 15-foot hot-stick clearance requirement cannot be determined from available plans. No cross-sections provided.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (survey requirement as required by AE Design)
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pad locations to overhead structures, building eaves, overhead conductors, or any enclosed/courtyard areas. Cross-section documentation required to verify vertical clearance compliance per AE Design requirements.

Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry) is not specified on electrical plan. Without equipment type, drainage slope requirement (liquid flow away from building for oil-filled equipment) cannot be verified on grading plan.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (additional clearance and access easements may be required)
findings.comment: Transformer easements or access easements around pads are not shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) or plat (Sheet 2). Easement width and extent for Austin Energy accessibility requirements cannot be verified.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.18.0 (obtain transformer pad detail from AE Design)
applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations (Northwest, West-middle, Southwest, East-middle, Southeast)
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not provided on the electrical plan. Five transformer pads are shown as generic blue square symbols without dimensions (e.g., 5'x5', 6'x6'). No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included in the site plan set. Pad dimensions cannot be verified as matching AE Design specifications for the proposed service type.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads near parking and driveway areas (Northwest, West-middle, Southwest pads)
findings.comment: No bollard details or specifications are shown on any transformer pad locations. The proximity of west-side transformer pads to parking aisles and driveway areas cannot be precisely measured from plan. Presence, absence, or proper spacing of required 4-inch diameter galvanized rigid metal posts cannot be verified from available documentation.
